_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. title.en: Feeling stupid is part of it

body.en: Talking to a bump feels ridiculous the first time. Every father who does it felt that. Do it badly for a week and it stops feeling like a performance.
body.hi: Pehli baar pet se baat karna ajeeb lagta hai. Har pita ko laga hai. Ek hafte kharaab tareeke se kijiye, phir yeh dikhawa lagna band ho jaayega.
